title: flow
description: A board of Commons FLOW (flow.md, flow-workshops.md, flow-graph.md, flow-bodies.md): one workshop of a commons and its items, as exported from the platform. An item is a node of the graph whose edges are its fields core, anchors, part_of (parent), raised_by, carried_by, delivered_by and observed_by. $defs hold an item, a comment and a target.

commons.description: the id of the commons whose workshop this is

core.description: the id of the CORE whose workshop this is (flow-graph R2)

humans.description: the handles of the humans who may be assignees (flow.md R16); without it, assignees are not checked against people

limits.description: per human handle, the most open items assigned to them at once (flow.md R24)

type.description: flow.md R6; `unknown` when the platform's type is none of these, so that the export never invents one

closed_as.description: how a closed item was closed

labels.description: Body labels only on an open item (flow.md R15)

assignees.description: the human who must act next (flow.md R16)

parent.description: the Epic or Story it hangs under (flow.md R12)

body.description: the item's one current state, in Markdown (flow.md R6, R7)

core.description: the id of the definite CORE its targets resolve in (CORE R2), never a repository; else the workshop's, inherited along part_of (flow-graph R2)

stroke.description: whether the work changes an orientation or fulfils one already decided (flow.md R11)

writes_model.description: what in the model the work writes, as paths or addresses; empty when it writes nothing (flow-graph R5)

carried_by.description: exactly one Body or Post, a record of the CORE's element 9 (flow-graph R6)

observed_by.description: claims of kind fact, measure or signal in the CORE's knowledge (flow-graph R9)

kind.description: `unknown` when the project's name tells no workshop kind, so that the export reports it rather than guessing

memberships.description: every workshop that holds the item, as exported (flow-workshops R6, flow.md R36)

comments_complete.description: false when the export could not read every comment; checks that need history then report a gap (flow.md R36)

author.description: the platform account; every agent writes through its human's account

body.description: its first line names the handle and the kind: delivery, position or decision (flow.md R8)

target.description: a MODEL address `<kind>:<slug>` (a step as `step:<stream>/<step>`), a binding identity `<kind>:<slug>#<field>:<target>` (a step's as `value-stream:<stream>/<step>#<field>:<target>`; MODEL R18, R22), or a requirement `<spec>#R<n>` (flow-graph R3)
